{{Top|leg}}
A '''laser ring''' was a single-charge [[Laser/Legends|laser]] disguised as a [[Signet ring/Legends|signet ring]]. It was powerful enough to disable a [[Service droid/Legends|service droid]], allowing [[Distinct Commander]] [[Bane Nothos]] to escape confinement aboard the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] [[Celestial (starship)|''Celestial'']].
